push: This pushes code to a shared repository. People with access can see it.
publish: This publishes changes that can affect other people.
send: This sends a message or posts a reply on your behalf.
unknown: This action may send information or change something outside this computer.
hint: In this browser, ask again before sharing code, publishing changes or sending messages, or when the effect is unclear.
deploy: This changes a shared environment and may affect people using it.
external: This changes something outside this computer on your behalf.
remote_read: This reads information from a shared deployment environment.
